routes.label: in person at an ONI office

note: The 2005 decree on the national identification card, as the ONI publishes it (signed at the Palais National on 1 June 2005; read 2026-11-03), art. 3: the card is issued to every Haitian of 18; its first issue is free; it is renewed every ten years on the holder's birthday. Until then the entry stood on the IRB of Canada's response (2026) quoting the decree, which also reports a 2017 bill for fifteen years and long delays with bribes to speed them; neither is modelled, nor is the time.

sources.title: Office National d'Identification (ONI), Décret (the decree on the national identification card, as the ONI publishes it), article 3
sources.said: Article 3.- La Carte d’Identification Nationale est délivrée à tout Haïtien ou Haïtienne qui a atteint l’âge de dix-huit ans accomplis. La délivrance de la Carte d’Identification Nationale est une obligation de l’Etat. La première délivrance de la Carte d’identification Nationale est gratuite. La Carte d’Identification Nationale sera renouvelée tous les dix (10) ans à la date de l’anniversaire de naissance du titulaire.
